content.value: Patients arrive at a clinic according to Poisson distribution at a rate of 30 patients <sub>per</sub> hour. The waiting room does not accommodate more than 14 patients. Examination time per patient is exponential with mean rate 20 per hour.
(i) Find the effective arrival rate at the clinic.
(ii) What is the probability that an arriving patient will not wait?
(iii) What is the average number of customers in the clinic?
